cohort: The study included 647 patients who underwent isolated coronary artery bypass graft surgery or coronary artery bypass graft surgery combined with atrial appendage occlusion, using a heart-lung machine at one institution between April 2019 and December 2020.
finding: The duration of extracorporeal circulation, intraoperative application of platelet concentrates, and usage of cold crystalloid cardioplegia (Bretschneider) independently predicted the development of vasoplegic syndrome.
